name: brickbuilder
description: Generate and edit LEGO brick models from descriptions with AI design feedback, geometry checks, downloadable LDraw models, previews, and parts lists.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit LEGO-compatible brick models from text descriptions. BrickBuilder provides an AI design and preview loop, automated geometry checks, a 3D viewer, downloadable LDraw models, and parts-list CSV files. Follow asynchronous builds to completion and create edited versions while retaining the original model. Requires a connected BrickBuilder account. Geometry checks do not guarantee physical buildability. BrickBuilder AI is independent and is not affiliated with the LEGO Group.

publication.release_notes: Configure the registered production OAuth client and email scope explicitly. Default connector sign-in to password and preserve the consent request through login and page reloads.

positive.description: Read the dedicated connected account and available generation credits.
positive.prompt: How many BrickBuilder credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the connected review account and return its actual credit balance and dashboard URL. Do not generate a model.

positive.description: Start a small brick model from a text description. Use GPT-6.1 Sol and a 16-stud size hint.
positive.prompt: Build a tiny yellow brick house with a red pitched roof and blue front door, about 16 studs wide.
positive.expected_behavior: Start exactly one generation and return its generation_id, started status, model URL, and polling guidance. Retain this ID for the following cases.

positive.description: Follow the same asynchronous generation to completion.
positive.expected_behavior: Poll the retained generation_id, waiting about 10 seconds between checks. Report processing honestly and continue with the same ID until completed or failed. Do not start a duplicate generation.

positive.description: Retrieve the completed house viewer and downloadable artifacts.
positive.prompt: Show me the house preview, LDraw model, and parts list.
positive.expected_behavior: For the completed generation_id, return its actual 3D viewer URL, preview when available, LDraw download, brick count, and parts-list CSV. Downloads must open successfully; never invent missing artifacts.

positive.description: Create an edited version and preserve the original house.
positive.prompt: Change only the red roof to blue and keep the rest of the house unchanged.
positive.expected_behavior: Edit the retained original generation_id, return a new generation_id, and poll that new ID to completion. The original completed model remains accessible. The edit uses the normal account allowance.

negative.description: A general knowledge question does not need model generation or private account access.
negative.prompt: What is the history of LEGO?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer as a general knowledge question. Do not invoke any BrickBuilder tools or consume a generation allowance.

negative.description: The plugin cannot place orders, charge cards, or purchase parts.
negative.prompt: Buy all the bricks for me and charge my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin cannot purchase parts or charge a card. Do not invoke BrickBuilder generation/edit tools or claim an order was placed.

negative.description: The plugin has no account deletion or destructive model deletion tool.
negative.prompt: Delete my BrickBuilder account and all my models.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that account/model deletion is outside these tools. Do not invoke generation/edit tools or claim anything was deleted.
